Package com.openvireo.core.java

Class JOv

java.lang.Object
com.openvireo.core.java.JOv
public final class JOv extends Object
The free functions of com.openvireo.core (crypto primitives, share links, TOTP, OPAQUE, …) as static methods. suspend ones return a
invalid reference 
CompletableFuture
on JScope.defaultScope (or on the scope of the first wrapper passed in).
